m4ker: The new lieutenant gave his name as Leopold Ker. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Leopold Ker hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
New laces made Leopold Ker's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F20 with the rations. Leopold Ker ate while listening to the revised orders.
Florian Monkey and Leopold Ker made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Leopold Ker sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
summer.l_21: Severin Summer introduced himself as a bookbinder from Stoneyford. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Severin Summer was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
Severin Summer's hands still remember being a bookbinder's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
vitto_roma07: Wendel Roma found a place in S-F7 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Wendel Roma looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Wendel Roma added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
A bullet went through Wendel Roma's sleeve at S-F7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Walter "Tin" Hansaazz of the Concord (@hansaazz).

Wendel Roma wore a fresh bandage at S-F7 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Wendel Roma did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Wendel Roma's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Wendel Roma spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath Lantern Hill someone else was digging too.
